title: Poorly made bag organizer; strips of edging peeled off
text:
Poorly made bag organizer; strips of edging peeled off. This is a poorly constructed four-compartment Ziplock bag organizer with one opening each for different types of bags such as quart, gallon, sandwich, and snack bags. The unit is hinged, so it can be unlocked in the front. This can be hung on the wall or be placed in a drawer that is large enough to hold it. There are two screws with plastic mollies provided but I only recommend securing it to a stud. There are also some rubberized "circles" on the bottom to keep it from sliding around a drawer. The clip closure allows one to open the entire unit to install the bags. However, I find it is just as easy to insert the bags through their holes as long as I am not filling with too many bags.

Unfortunately, this is so poorly made I cannot recommend it. First, the interior has gouges on the inside. Second, they put their lousy name on the front and it isn't even done well. I do not want the name Fozobaiy on the top of the gallon compartment. In fact, I don't want to see the name at all. Third, the edging of the container peeled off. It is as if this is laminate instead of wood. This is an embarrassment.

Overall, this is a lousy bag organizer of substandard quality. The current price of $39.99 is outrageous for this quality. Other options that are available are this [[ASIN:B09D5Y63D1 one]] if one is looking for four separate compartments. For a variety of organizers (separate and one unit), then I recommend this [[ASIN:B09KMNHM2J one]] or this [[ASIN:B09VGP1WRL one]]. For one full unit only, then I recommend this [[ASIN:B09RF759BM rustic organizer]]. I tried all of these and the style purchased is based on what one desires.
